crossRefs.note: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on…

translations.web: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.
translations.bsb: I cannot keep silent about his limbs, his power and graceful form.
translations.kjv: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
translations.asv: I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, Nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.
